domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers (including regrouping and simplification)

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator (LCD) and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Explicitly determines an LCD/LCM for two denominators
Rewrites one or both fractions (including the fractional parts of mixed numbers) into equivalent fractions with a shared denominator as setup for subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and no conversion is performed
Only rewrites a whole number as n/n (e.g., 1 = 3/3) without an LCD step or without changing denominators between the two fractions

skills.name: Subtract aligned fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions once denominators match by subtracting numerators and keeping the common denominator (including within mixed-number subtraction).
inclusion_criteria: Performs fraction subtraction with like denominators (whether originally like or made like via conversion)
Shows or implies numerator subtraction over a common denominator (a/b − c/b = (a−c)/b), including results of 0 or negative intermediate fraction differences
exclusion_criteria: Only subtracts whole-number parts with no fractional subtraction
Only reduces/simplifies a fraction or converts to a mixed number without performing a subtraction

skills.name: Mixed-number regrouping
skills.definition: Rewrite or regroup whole and fractional parts (including borrowing 1 as b/b, rewriting a whole number as a mixed number, or converting mixed to improper) to make subtraction possible or to set up the subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Borrows/regroups from the whole part to the fraction part (e.g., decrease whole by 1 and add b/b to the fractional part) to avoid a negative fractional subtraction
Rewrites a whole number as a mixed number with a chosen denominator (e.g., 3 as 3 0/5 or 2 as 1 3/3) to enable subtracting a fraction
Converts between mixed numbers and improper fractions as part of setting up a subtraction (not merely as final formatting)
exclusion_criteria: Only finds an LCD and converts fractions to a common denominator (tag S01 instead)
Only performs the numerator subtraction once the expression is already set up (tag S02 instead)
Only simplifies/reduces or converts the final result to a mixed number/integer (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the final fraction to lowest terms and express the final value in an appropriate form (integer, proper fraction, or mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: Reduces a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor
Simplifies 0/b to 0 or otherwise expresses an integer result
Converts an improper fraction to a mixed number (or combines whole+fraction) as the final answer form
exclusion_criteria: Only performs common-denominator conversion or subtraction without any reduction or final-form conversion
Intermediate conversions/regrouping used to enable subtraction rather than to present the final answer (tag S03 instead)
